title: On the cyclic limiting behavior of the restarted Arnoldi algorithm for real symmetric matrices with restart length $s=2$
summary: We prove that the restarted Arnoldi algorithm for real symmetric matrices with restart length $s=2$ has a cyclic limiting behavior. In the terminology established in (arXiv:2209.14579), this is a proof of the ACI($s$) conjecture for $A=A^T\in \mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ and $s=2$. As explained in (arXiv:2209.14579), this also proves the Forsythe conjecture (Numerische Mathematik, 11 (1968), pp. 57-76) about the limiting behavior of the conjugate gradient method and positive definite $A=A^T\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ for $s=2$.
